title: On a purchase order the inactive message replaces the special-order offer
custom_steps:
1. New PO → part field → type P1 in full
  2. Tab out
  3. Open an existing PO → Add item → type P1
custom_expected:
1. Dropdown shows only "P1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."; no special-order offer
  2. The same text shows as the field error; the line can't be saved
  3. Same message; nothing added
